福島県・会津美里町の山際の集落に建つ、SHINDO第一拠点「理空（りくう）」。解: Rikū, SHINDO's first base, stands in a hillside hamlet in Aizumisato, Fukushima. A 250-year-old farmhouse slated for demolition, restored over two years with Aizu craftsmen. The origin of its name, the history it carries, its natural-material architecture, and what it means as a place.
福島県・会津美里町。2年越しの古民家再生を経て、2025年1月に完成した、SHI: Aizumisato, Fukushima. SHINDO's first base, completed in January 2025 after a two-year restoration of an old farmhouse.
福島県・会津美里町の山際の集落に建つ、SHINDO第一拠点「理空（りくう）」。2: Rikū, SHINDO's first base, stands in a hillside hamlet in Aizumisato, Fukushima. Completed in January 2025 after two years of restoring an old farmhouse, it is our place for creating together in good health. Many meaningful ways of using Rikū are now opening up.

NAME ── 名の由来: NAME ── Where the name comes from
「理空」という名は、自然農法無の会の代表・児島が、ある日、夢の中で受け取ったもの: The name Rikū came to Kojima, head of Munokai Natural Farm, in a dream one day. Kū — emptiness — is the complete state in which nothing exists because everything does. Ri is principle. The name carries a prayer: that this be a place where people gather to intuit that principle through every kind of practice.
250年を生き抜いてきた家。: A house that has lived through 250 years.
解体寸前の出会い: An encounter on the verge of demolition
2022年秋、この家はすでに解体が決まっていました。カヤ葺き屋根は無の会の堆肥の: In autumn 2022, the house was already scheduled for demolition. Its thatched roof was to become the main ingredient in Munokai's compost, and the building itself was to be torn down. We asked for the work to be postponed, and took the house on.
会津百姓一揆を生き残った家: A house that survived the Aizu peasant uprising
江戸中期には建っていた元名主（庄屋）の家。武田信玄の末裔・馬場美濃守の一族が拓い: The former village headman's house, standing since the mid-Edo period. It was the first house of the hamlet, founded by the family of Baba Mino-no-kami, a descendant of Takeda Shingen. It came through the Aizu yonaoshi uprising of 1868, and the hatchet marks left by the peasants who stormed it remain in the pillars to this day.
古民家は、自然と共に生きる知恵を建築に集約したもの。それを壊すのではなく「活かし: An old farmhouse is the wisdom of living with nature, condensed into architecture. Rather than destroy it, we chose to put it to use and carry it on. Receiving the intentions of the land's ancestors and of the peasants who joined the uprising — that was the concept behind Rikū's restoration.
柱に残るナタ傷／再生前の外観: Hatchet marks in the pillars ／ the exterior before restoration
RESTORATION ── 会津の職人大工と、2年越しの再生: RESTORATION ── Two years with Aizu's master carpenters
想定の二倍も上回った現実を、ギリギリで乗り越えて。: Getting through a reality twice as hard as we expected — just barely.
施工をしたのは、自然素材による健康住宅を長年手がけてきた、地元工務店・志木。十代: The work was done by Shiki, a local builder with a long record of healthy houses made from natural materials. Led by a master carpenter who has built more than 700 houses since his mid-teens, it is a team of highly skilled craftsmen rare anywhere in Japan.
建材の急騰、施工途中からの融資申請など—— 想定を二倍ほど上回る現実を、パートナ: Soaring material costs, applying for loans partway through construction — a reality roughly twice as hard as we had expected, overcome one step at a time with the support of our partners. SHINDO's business model was born out of this two-year restoration.
そして、2025年1月、ついに理空が完成。: And in January 2025, Rikū was finally complete.
足場に囲まれた再生中の理空: Rikū under restoration, surrounded by scaffolding
ARCHITECTURE ── 建築の特徴: ARCHITECTURE ── What makes the building special
よく氣が巡る、自然素材の家。: A natural-material house where energy flows well.
最高品質の自然素材と職人技: The finest natural materials and craftsmanship
自然乾燥の木材を基調に、古材、竹、漆喰、土、古代海泥、炭、銅、天然石などで建てら: Built around naturally dried timber, with reclaimed wood, bamboo, plaster, earth, ancient marine clay, charcoal, copper, and natural stone. Japan's finest natural materials bring the energy of the interior into balance.
自然と氣が循環する構造: A structure where air and energy circulate naturally
空氣を流す自然建材のおかげや、建物の空氣口の配置工夫によって、屋内の空氣が自然に: Thanks to breathable natural materials and the careful placement of vents, air moves naturally through the house. Breathing comes easier, sleep deepens, and bodily awareness recovers.
独特な遠赤外線を放つ海泥土壁: Marine-clay walls that radiate far-infrared warmth
壁は天然の古代海泥の土壁。調湿効果だけでなく、コンスタントに遠赤外線を放していま: The walls are earthen, mixed with natural ancient marine clay. Beyond regulating humidity, they steadily emit far-infrared radiation. The clay-blended walls make the house comfortable without air conditioning in summer and feel warmer than the air temperature in winter — a welcome quality in Aizu's humid summers.
MEANING ── 場としての意義: MEANING ── What the place is for
細胞も、意識も、活性化する家。: A house that awakens the cells and the mind.
理空が目指したのは「贅沢さ」や「快適さ」ではありません。感受性や判断力、開かれた: Rikū was never meant to be luxurious or merely comfortable. It was built as a space where sensitivity, judgment, and an open mind grow of their own accord. In a natural environment of strong contrasts, body and mind quietly come alive, and good work and good relationships take root.
ここは、暮らしの実験が持ち寄られ、関係が深まり、次の創造が生まれていく——SHI: This is where experiments in living are brought together, relationships deepen, and the next creation begins — SHINDO's place of restoration and creation, the main house from which the circle of co-creation spreads.

PROOF ── なぜ、ここが「実行力の証拠」なのか: PROOF ── Why this place is evidence that we deliver
計画書はいくらでも書けます。けれど、解体が決まっていた築250年を超える古民家を: Anyone can write a plan. But taking on a 250-year-old farmhouse slated for demolition, overcoming the wall of funding, and rebuilding it over two years with a team of master craftsmen — that experience lives on in how we build our projects today. That Rikū is complete and in use is our solid track record.
一軒の古民家再生が、構想と事業のかたちを決めた。: One farmhouse restoration shaped our vision and our business.
理空は、SHINDOの拠点であると同時に、SHINDOの起点です。解体寸前の家を: Rikū is SHINDO's base and also its starting point. From the moment we decided to take on a house about to be demolished, we tested our criteria in practice: inherit rather than destroy, choose what accords with the principles of nature, make the people who live there healthier. It was during these two years that scattered ideas came together as the Showa Village vision, and that our current business model — construction, farming, energy, and shared learning working as one — was born.
つまり理空は、コンセプトの実物見本です。ここで起きたことを、次はひとつの集落でや: In other words, Rikū is a working sample of the concept. What happened here, we will try next at the scale of a whole hamlet. That is the vision for Onogawa, Showa Village.
